rule: inputs (catalog ids, with counts) -> output (a catalog id); crafted only in a sealed shelter (at its workbench) or parked in the dock; tier 2 needs the Matter Loom (R14), tier 3 the Loom and a tier-2 machine

recipes.name: Tetrabrachion
recipes.hint: Four hands remember what one forgot. Feed them forty small fires.
recipes.function: Grabber upgrade: four arms replace the claw. Picks up to 4 items per press, lifts drums and car parts the claw cannot, reach +25%.

recipes.name: Heliostat Rail
recipes.hint: Drink the sweetness, keep the tin: the sun needs a cradle.
recipes.function: Unlocks one solar mount slot on the bin (craft up to 8). The panel itself is consumed into the rail.

recipes.name: Dioscuri Rig
recipes.hint: Two brothers, one heartbeat, a screen that watches both.
recipes.function: Second arm pair on the back of the bin: carry while grabbing, double pickup speed.

recipes.name: Lumen Vigil
recipes.hint: What drinks the dark cannot drink this light.
recipes.function: Wandering UV-C sentry around the shelter. Leeches will not cross its 8 m radius for 3 nights.

recipes.name: Mole Courier
recipes.hint: Lay a fork on its back and give it eyes; it will dig for you.
recipes.function: Autonomous scout: fetches one marked item per day and maps cadmium puddles on the minimap.

recipes.name: Roentgen Furnace
recipes.hint: Wind the copper, crush the silver tins, and the drum will hum through midnight.
recipes.function: Shelter generator: turns diesel cans into charge at night (1 can = 10% bin battery).

recipes.name: Skiagraph Pillar
recipes.hint: Stand the bones upright and walls become rumours.
recipes.function: Needs a Roentgen Furnace nearby. Reveals hidden or buried supplies through walls within 15 m for 20 s.

recipes.name: Coherent Lance
recipes.hint: Six green throats sing one straight note.
recipes.function: Cuts barricades and fences (opens shortcuts) and burns a latched leech off in 2 s.

recipes.name: Echo Psalter
recipes.hint: Listen to the mud. It is full of things that were thrown away.
recipes.function: Pings buried items in mud and puddles within 10 m.

recipes.name: Cadmium Leachfilter
recipes.hint: The yellow water is sick. Give it new kidneys.
recipes.function: Purifies cadmium puddle water into coolant (consumable: repairs aged panels, cools motors for faster driving).

recipes.name: Somnus Bellows
recipes.hint: Even hunger sleeps if you breathe for it.
recipes.function: Releases a sleep cloud at the shelter door: leeches inside 6 m stay dormant for one night.

recipes.name: Iron Breath
recipes.hint: A shelter that cannot breathe will rust in its sleep.
recipes.function: Shelter air scrubber: no overnight corrosion, items stored inside keep full value.

recipes.name: Lazarus Clamps
recipes.hint: Teeth taken from what bit you will bite back once.
recipes.function: One-shot revive at 0% battery (restores 25%) and shocks a latched leech off.

recipes.name: Matter Loom
recipes.hint: Every wrapper remembers being a shape.
recipes.function: Shelter crafting station: unlocks tier-2 recipes and prints fuses and bolts from plastic trash.

recipes.name: Arc Forge
recipes.hint: Marry the rust to the lightning and it will stand up.
recipes.function: Builds and upgrades shelter walls, roof and doors from scrap.

recipes.name: Ley Junction
recipes.hint: Where the street's veins meet, store the noon for midnight.
recipes.function: Shelter power hub: night storage and 2 extra panel circuits. Daylight only charges it; it carries Troll-E through the night.

recipes.name: Charge Oracle
recipes.hint: Ask the cell how long it has. It will not lie to this.
recipes.function: Shows true charge on found batteries and each solar panel's age tier and efficiency.

recipes.name: Photon Altar
recipes.hint: Lay the tired suns flat and they remember noon.
recipes.function: Restores one aged panel one tier per day (ruined to aged to new), at the cost of the four sacrificed panels.

recipes.name: Salamander Lung
recipes.hint: Cold batteries bleed faster. Give the night a fever.
recipes.function: Shelter heater: burns diesel at night, so night drain is 30% lower while docked.

recipes.name: Dynamo Heart
recipes.hint: The old lifter's heart still wants to run downhill.
recipes.function: Drive upgrade: +25% top speed and regenerative braking on slopes.

recipes.name: Leech Collar
recipes.hint: Wear the mouth of the thing that fed on you.
recipes.function: Passive: the first leech each night that latches on is zapped off automatically.

recipes.name: Contrast Syringe
recipes.hint: Dye the blood of the machine and it will run like a rumour.
recipes.function: Consumable overdrive: 60 s at double speed with double drain.

recipes.name: Warmth Eye
recipes.hint: They are cold. Watch for the holes in the heat.
recipes.function: Shelter sensor: warns 30 s before leeches approach.

recipes.name: Small Vigil
recipes.hint: A pocket of noon you can set down in the mud.
recipes.function: Placeable UV lamp: leech-free 4 m radius for one night.

recipes.name: Printed fuse
recipes.hint: Every wrapper remembers being a shape.
recipes.function: The Matter Loom prints one fuse from three pieces of plastic trash.
